title: LOLA GDR south-polar stereographic DEM, 75°S–90°S, 240 m/pixel
summary: Regional context topography of the lunar south-polar region from the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter Gridded Data Record. The first terrain product for ingestion development; site-scale analysis requires the higher-resolution products listed in docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.
provider: NASA Planetary Data System — Geosciences Node
product_family: LOLA Gridded Data Record (GDR), polar stereographic

files.name: LDEM_75S_240M.LBL
files.description: PDS3 detached label: map projection, scaling factor, offset, units and reference radius. Authoritative metadata for the image. Stored under the upper-case name used by the archive's label conventions.

files.name: LDEM_75S_240M.IMG
files.description: Gridded topography raster described by the label. The server publishes lower-case file names but the label's ^IMAGE pointer names 'LDEM_75S_240M.IMG'; it is stored under that upper-case name so the pointer resolves on case-sensitive file systems.

spatial.projection: Polar stereographic, south pole (center latitude −90°, center longitude 0°, east-positive) on a 1737.4 km sphere — per the PDS label
spatial.vertical_reference: Heights relative to the 1737.4 km reference sphere (radius = height + 1 737 400 m), per the PDS label

units: Raster values are 16-bit signed integers (LSB). Per the PDS label: HEIGHT (m) = DN × SCALING_FACTOR (0.5), relative to a reference sphere of radius OFFSET (1 737 400 m); PLANETARY_RADIUS (m) = DN × SCALING_FACTOR + OFFSET. Heights are relative to the sphere, not to a geoid. Ingestion code reads scaling and offset from the label rather than from this manifest.
citation: Smith, D. E., et al. (2010). The Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter Investigation on the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Mission. Space Science Reviews, 150, 209–241. doi:10.1007/s11214-009-9512-y. Data set: LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0, NASA Planetary Data System (use the exact data set citation from the PDS product page).
usage: NASA PDS archive data, publicly available. Cite the instrument paper and the PDS data set.

verification.note: URLs, byte sizes and SHA-256 values confirmed on 2026-11-04 by an independent session with direct access to pds-geosciences.wustl.edu (files downloaded and hashed, label inspected). Re-verified the same day by a full acquisition and `lunaris-data verify` from the LUNARIS development environment: every file matched its pinned SHA-256.

notes: Label contents observed on 2026-11-04 (independent verification): 3812 × 3812 samples, LSB 16-bit integers; scaling 0.5 m per DN; polar stereographic on a 1737.4 km sphere centred on −90°/0°; LINE_PROJECTION_OFFSET = SAMPLE_PROJECTION_OFFSET = 1905.5 px; coverage −75° to −90°; reference frame 'MEAN EARTH/POLAR AXIS OF DE421'; DN range −15529 to 14049. Milestone 02 ingestion parses these from the label and tests against these observed values.

240 m/pixel is regional context only; slope and hazard assessment at landing-site scale requires the 5–20 m/pixel south-polar products (see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md § Candidate products for Milestone 02).
